module_definitions.hierarchy: HASTEN-inspired: seen-class family mean visual anchors appended to existing P at unit total norm per family, families with >=2 seen children only; R=(I+PP^T)^-1, original mu/Q untouched. Coarse name-based research families, not validated medical ontology; no CLIP/hyperbolic/GPT/future images.
module_definitions.local: COMPOSE-inspired: same two ViT branch final tokens, four fixed quadrants, CLS cosine-softmax patch pooling, per-image mean centering/L2 normalization, per-class mean local anchors at 1/2 scale per region added to P. Existing global feature/head retained. No slots/router/replay/Chamfer/support adaptation. Historical local centers use existing global shift proxy.
module_definitions.paced: PaLoRA-inspired history pacing: task adapter parameter-increment vectors; 95% energy effective rank of historical Gram; whole original cosine LR schedule scaled by 1/sqrt(max(1,R)). This is parameter-update history rank, not original LoRA effective rank/nullspace; no original theorem claimed.
module_definitions.fusion: DAF-inspired task-end-only Eq3/14 fusion; historical arithmetic mean prior, previous global and optimized current adapter; alpha1.25 and beta clip[.001,.499]. Curvature uses mean squared batch CE gradients from one canonical current-fit pass (batch approximation, not per-example Fisher). Near-zero displacement uses curvature-only beta. Current initial global adapter retained instead of resetting to prior; fused features re-extracted and bank transported by original proxy.
